page.notes: Doubtful readings: "alias" may carry an accent over the a (aliàs). The word "ne" at the start of the line "ne propter" has a stroke above it in the scan. The word "diceren!" has a mark over the r that may be a printing error for diceret. "varijs" and "beneficijs" have a medial j that is a vowel i in this print; I normalised it to i.
